remarks: This stunning, move-in-ready townhouse offers three levels of spacious, updated luxury living in a prime Stamford location. Thoughtfully refreshed from top to bottom, the home features all newly refinished oak floors, a newly renovated primary bath, fresh paint throughout the entire townhouse, and a brand-new epoxy garage floor. The front entrance leads to an open-concept main level with tall ceilings and abundant natural light. The living room features a charming bay window, gas fireplace, and crown molding, seamlessly flowing into the dining room with a tray ceiling, cove lighting, and sliders that open to a private deck-perfect for your morning coffee or evening cocktails. The updated kitchen boasts granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, ample cabinetry, and a pantry closet. A stylish half bath completes the main level. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers a walk-in closet and a renovated ensuite bath with dual vanities, a jetted soaking tub, and a newly updated shower. A second large bedroom and a full hall bath round out this floor. The third level provides incredible versatility-an expansive, sun-filled bedroom that can easily serve as a family room, home office, or guest suite, complete with another full bath and generous closet space. Additional highlights new tankless hot water heater, new HVAC, freshly painted throughout, renovated primary bath, epoxy garage.
